# secrets: drop the dead weller user key and rekey (separate PR, based on main)

weller was reinstalled today; its old `/home` was wiped by disko. The `patrick` user-key list in
`secrets/keys.nix` still carries that install's user key:

    ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAICkzfSlbK9YX3KztdvtgfyJelixdI6QN3c41eme9HOWv  # weller

Its private half no longer exists anywhere; it is dead weight in every secret's recipient list.

## Coordination — read this first

PR #768 (branch `agent/20260830-2140-0f4f7e9a`) replaces weller's HOST key and rekeys all
secrets; the owner is merging it as soon as CI passes. Your PR must be independent of it and
must not conflict badly: base on `origin/main`, do NOT touch the host-key binding. Because both
PRs rewrite every `.age` file, yours will need a rebase + fresh `agenix -r` after #768 merges —
that is expected; the pipeline dispatches a fix agent on conflict, or you handle it if #768 is
already merged by the time you start (check `gh pr view 768 --json state,mergedAt`; if merged,
rebase onto the new main first).

## Do

1. Delete that one line from the `patrick` list in `secrets/keys.nix`. Nothing else in the file.
2. From `secrets/`, `nix run github:ryantm/agenix -- -r`. This host's user key
   (`~/.ssh/id_ed25519`, the `# classic-laddie` entry) is a recipient, so no prompts. PASTE the
   output; every `*.age` must be rewritten.
3. Verify and PASTE: `nix flake check` final lines, and
   `nix run github:ryantm/agenix -- -d user-password.age > /dev/null && echo ok` from `secrets/`.

## PR

Title: `secrets: drop the dead weller user key`. Body: the removed key's fingerprint
(`ssh-keygen -lf`), why it is dead (drive wiped 2026-08-30), a note that weller's NEW user key
will be added once generated, and that this PR depends on being rekeyed after #768.

Touch only `secrets/keys.nix` and the `.age` files agenix rewrites. Never print decrypted secret
content. Commit and push before long verification.
